data.rationale: The proposal follows the same flights → hotel → tour → note procedure with the right parameters, but it misses the 8+ review-score filter on hotels, takes "top/cheapest" for the "first (best)" flight, and omits the "do not click Select/Book/Reserve" constraints, and it does not mention the Google consent page "Reject all" step or "New note" click, so an automation built from it could pick the wrong hotel or take a booking action.
